percentile: nearest rank; p50/p95 calculated from each individual frame
timing: Counters, malloc logger and JS entry wrappers disabled; stage clocks remain
entryCounting: Separate frame wraps both addon export tables; includes unguarded value/glyph APIs; no malloc profiling in this pass
frame: CPU: clear + input + dirty/model update + context update + render + display
presentation: Vsync disabled; no GPU timer/fence; swap can wait for WindowServer
workload: Actual bound rows, 1px height; width changes 1/2/3px; 320x240 clip
callbackFixture: Custom views compute width in JS; default native data-attr views update data-value
slowFixture: custom-attribute also calls setAttribute per row; measured separately at 1k rows

scope.crossings: Actual RmlUi/SFML addon exports and explicit V8 callbacks
scope.sfml: clear records shared commands; flush and display each submit once
scope.native: Direct C++ fill of the same native backings; same model/layout/render pipeline
scope.allocations: macOS main-thread malloc-family logger; V8 arena suballocations/VM/GPU excluded
scope.copies: Numeric resize, SFML geometry expansion, merged geometry staging, command snapshots and owned glyph/effect copies only
scope.uploads: Successful renderer geometry VBO updates and source texture uploads
scope.draws: SFML renderer draw submissions by category; not GPU timer queries
scope.memory: GC-before snapshots; RSS, V8 heap, external and arrayBuffers
scope.ownership: Custom data-factory instance visits at outer boundary exit

outputChecks: Every actual row attribute and width = value + 1; checked outside all measurement intervals
